method.previousTopics: Enumerate exact non-directory entries in six baseline topics; compare names, regular-file status and raw SHA-256 to the complete pre-navigation entries.
method.backend: Enumerate all .gd and .mjs.txt files in scripts/backends; compare exact set and SHA-256 to the pre-navigation snapshot.
method.historicalTracked: Enumerate HEAD docs/test-results blobs with git ls-tree; verify complete path/mode/blob identity matches the previous HUD preservation baseline; independently read every distinct Git blob with git cat-file --batch and SHA-256 its raw bytes, then compare each baseline SHA-256 and current regular file to that blob. New untracked or pre-existing uncommitted evidence is outside HEAD and is separately handled by the six-topic baseline.
method.tupleDigest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON lines [path,mode,gitBlobId,priorExpectedSha256,gitBlobSha256,currentSha256,regularFile], sorted by path, compact separators; newline after each tuple.
